statement: SDL identifies the Linux Steam Virtual Gamepad as Valve VID/PID 28de:11ff, scans/orders its slots, and ignores 11ff by default unless SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_ALLOW_STEAM_VIRTUAL_GAMEPAD is true. SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_IGNORE_DEVICES and SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_IGNORE_DEVICES_EXCEPT then govern generic VID/PID filtering. InputPlumber reports Steam often sets ignore devices at game launch, but exact Steam Stable 1792618285 environment and per-game configuration are not proven by that second-hand source.

applicability.revision: Wired 28de:1302; pinned kernel 7.3-rc1, SDL3 6defbc0, sc26re 518fa; Steam Stable 1792618285 physical observation separately scoped D9
applicability.firmware: Replacement firmware is not retail device proof; observed physical D9 firmware build 0x6ACFF323 belongs to #101
applicability.scope: O3 SDL and O4 secondary Steam launch evidence; do not assume game can access 11ff without SDL allow flag.
